brand.name: Dalloyou
brand.longTagline: A house of refined pastry, where French technique meets the warmth of the Levant.

about.short: Dalloyou is a Riyadh house of pastry built on a single principle: nothing leaves our kitchen that we wouldn't serve our family. Each cake, tart, and chocolate is made by hand in small batches, with French technique applied to ingredients we trust — pistachio from Gaziantep, butter from Normandy, dates from Al-Qassim. The result is patisserie that feels both rooted and quietly modern.
